text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Runnin' blindly in races ain't gonna give 
ya any thrill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Far from having fun, at best it'll just 
end in a boring result."

Nakayama Festa seems unhappy about running 
consecutive races. It might be best to 
review her race schedule.
